column1: # corpus/as-drawn/sources.tsv: the recipe for every file in this folder.
# One row per committed <stem>.stl. Each has an empty <stem>.asdrawn marker beside it.
#   stem           the model name; the committed file is corpus/as-drawn/<stem>.stl
#   source         the provisioned original, relative to the repository root
#   turn           x180 = turned 180 deg about X by plinth_mesh::turn_binary_stl_x180;
#                  none = an exact byte copy (the source is already drawn the way the owner wants it)
#   source_sha256  sha256 of the provisioned source; a different source is refused
#   result_sha256  sha256 of the committed file
# Made, and checked, ONLY by the example (never by hand):
#   cargo run --profile gate --offline -p plinth-mesh --example as_drawn_corpus            # write
#   cargo run --profile gate --offline -p plinth-mesh --example as_drawn_corpus -- --check # verify only
# plinth-orient's `as_drawn_corpus` tests regenerate every row from its source and compare byte for byte.
